verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's documented Dives feature lets users ask questions in natural language and get AI-generated, interactive dashboards they can refine conversationally and save as live answers. Built-in AI Functions for text analysis and SQL generation, and the remote MCP server's natural-language analytics, add AI-driven analysis of the user's data. Missing for 10: proactive AI insights or suggestions (beyond answering prompts), clear evidence that the conversational Dive flow runs natively in the MotherDuck UI rather than through an external agent, independent or hands-on corroboration.
